backend/agents/evaluator_agent.py: Evaluator node, no LLM: turns stored session questions into grader inputs, grades a test with the local grader in one embedding call on a worker thread (reusing a pre-graded answer whose text is unchanged), writes feedback from templates, inserts test_results with score 0-10, feedback and confidence per answer, updates the rolling average in reading_progress and returns grades and one decisions entry; the first node of the submit flow; a question with no evidence is graded against the passage at low confidence.
backend/agents/evaluation/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.agents.evaluation, answer grading with no LLM.
backend/agents/evaluation/feedback.py: Feedback for a graded answer, pure: render(grade, evidence) builds one or two sentences from fixed templates, the question's key terms and a verbatim evidence snippet; low confidence gives no verdict, closed questions name the expected answer, free text says what was captured and missed and never 'correct'.
backend/agents/evaluation/grader.py: Answer grader: pure decide(GradeInput) gives a 0..1 score, a high, medium or low confidence, matched and missing key terms, the rule used and its components; cloze and multiple choice by exact or rapidfuzz match, free text by a weighted sum of evidence cosine, key-term coverage and a relevance check; grade_all embeds a test's free-text answers in one call with the embedder it is given.
backend/agents/graph.py: Builds the LangGraph workflow: event-driven flows from __start__ routed on state['event']: start_session -> planner; finish_reading -> test_generator; submit_answers -> evaluator -> knowledge_state -> optimizer -> planner (the optimizer is skipped when every grade is low-confidence, and an evaluator error ends the run); abandon -> optimizer.
backend/agents/optimizer_agent.py: Optimizer node, no LLM: reads progress and the stored pace recommendation (previous multiplier, recent percentages, recent question outcomes, question mix), the book's recent sessions (this one's words and minutes, earlier abandonments) and the profile speed; calls optimizer.pace.decide; stores the recommendation with its history and the re-read queue (creating the progress row for older books); returns it with one decisions entry. On abandon there is no test: the stopped session counts as abandoned and no score is recorded.
backend/agents/planner_agent.py: Planner node, no LLM: reads progress (creating it on a first session with nothing read), candidate sections, their concepts, the reader's mastery, question difficulty per section and the optimizer's last pace; calls planner.strategy.decide; pops a re-read from the queue only when a session starts with it (after a submit the plan is a preview); returns plan, session_plan and one decisions entry.
backend/agents/state.py: AgentState TypedDict shared by all agent nodes: identity, the event (start or submit), one output key per agent (plan, grades, mastery_updates, policy_adjustments), the append-only decisions audit trail (agent, inputs_summary, output_summary, reason, duration_ms, built by decision()) and errors (operator.add reducers), and the older keys the current nodes and routers still use.
backend/tests/test_agent_state.py: Pytest: AgentState declares the pipeline keys and keeps the old ones, decisions and errors are append-only through a compiled graph, event takes only start or submit, every key a node returns is declared, and the evaluator returns only its own decision.
backend/agents/test_generator_agent.py: Test generator node, no LLM: assembles the session's test from the question bank (question_bank.assemble_session_test) in the planner's question mix and returns it with one decisions entry; run by the finish_reading flow.
backend/dependencies.py: FastAPI dependencies: get_current_user resolves a Supabase JWT to a user id through supabase.auth.get_user (anything else is a 401); require_model waits up to EMBED_WAIT_SECONDS for the embedding model, starting a load if none is running, and answers 503 with Retry-After before the endpoint runs.
backend/main.py: FastAPI app: CORS through backend/cors.py, the seven routers and /health (status, model_ready, timestamp; never waits on the model); its lifespan preloads the embedding model on a background thread unless EMBED_PRELOAD=0 and starts the ingestion sweep (backend/services/ingestion_worker.py) unless INGEST_SWEEP=0. Starts no other process.
backend/routers/mastery.py: GET /mastery?book_id=&limit=&offset=: the caller's concept mastery rows with their labels, weakest first, one page per call with the total; a page past the last row is empty.
backend/agents/knowledge_state/agent.py: The I/O around mastery.decide: record_test reads the reader's mastery rows for the concepts a graded test's questions name, moves them and upserts them with last_seen and next_review, once per session id (no round trip when no question names a concept); knowledge_state_node wraps it as the submit flow's second node, a failure being an errors entry.
backend/tests/test_api_mastery.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: record_test writes one row per concept with review dates, weighs low confidence, applies an event once and makes no round trip without concepts; GET /mastery needs a token and returns only the caller's rows, weakest first, with labels, paginated, empty past the end.
backend/mcp_server.py: Standalone FastMCP server with three Supabase tools (reading history, comprehension trend, chunk context); not started by the app since C3.4 and not called by any agent; kept for manual use.
backend/nlp/__init__.py: Package marker for backend.nlp, the local NLP building blocks (no API calls).
backend/nlp/concepts.py: Concepts of a chunk: YAKE key phrases, normalised (lower case, stopwords stripped, plurals reduced), near-duplicates merged by rapidfuzz, embedding cosine or shared words, each with a stable concept key slug and a 0..1 weight.
backend/nlp/embedder.py: Local embeddings: one thread-safe fastembed model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384 dimensions, cache in FASTEMBED_CACHE), preloaded and warmed on a daemon thread at startup unless EMBED_PRELOAD=0, or loaded on first use; a ready event that requests wait on and /health reports, and the load error if any; embed and embed_one return unit-length float32 vectors.
backend/nlp/text.py: Pure text utilities, standard library only: normalize (PDF hyphenation, line breaks, quotes), split_sentences with an abbreviation guard, tokenize, STOPWORDS, content_words, and informativeness, a 0..1 sentence score.
backend/routers/agent.py: Empty APIRouter mounted at /agent; defines no endpoints.
backend/routers/auth.py: GET /auth/profile and POST /auth/profile/calibrate: read the profile and save the calibrated reading speed.
backend/routers/books.py: Book endpoints: upload (read 1 MB at a time to the per-file limit, sha256 and size stored, the per-reader cap on cloud-kept bytes, a device-only mode that stores no file) to Storage, record a processing_jobs row and ingest after the response; list (with cover_url and the caller's reading progress, null before a first session); details with progress; pages (GET, read-only: chunks start..end of the caller's book, at most four, index, content, word count and blocks; no session touched); status poll with the job's status, progress and cursor; resume a failed or stuck book's ingestion from its cursor; delete. GET /books/{id}/file: a short-lived signed URL for the owner's stored original (404 for device-only books); resume refuses a device-only book.
backend/routers/dashboard.py: GET /dashboard: aggregates book progress, scores over time, reading streak, words this week and recent feedback; its five reads run at once, only the needed columns are selected, and test answers are read a page of the newest results at a time until three feedback quotes are found.
backend/routers/sessions.py: Session lifecycle endpoints (evaluate-single and submit-answers wait for the embedding model through require_model), through backend/agents/workflow.py: start (only on the caller's own book: 404 otherwise, 503 when ownership cannot be read (C15.2, issue 17); the start_session flow plans; it also sends each chunk's reader blocks, the book's title, author, toc, file format and storage mode (C17.5) and the chapter in effect before the first chunk, read alongside; the session row is created here and the finish_reading flow assembles the test in the background, warming the grading model), finish-reading (returns the public part of the test, running finish_reading inline if it is not ready), evaluate-single (grades one answer inline and caches it; tells the client nothing), submit-answers (claims the session first, so it is graded once; a resubmit gets the stored result rebuilt from test_results; one submit_answers run: grades, mastery, pace and the next plan; returns score, feedback, confidence, the pace recommendation and the next session), position (PUT: the reader's place, {chunk_index} with C12's {block_id, char_offset} or (C17.5) an original-view anchor {kind: 'pdf', page, quads, text} or {kind: 'epub', cfi, text} (ANCHORS A1, A3), validated against the caller's session and the book's chunks, stored in reading_progress.position only, never creating the row; start returns it, a failed read giving none), abandon (marks the session, then runs the abandon flow after the response), get; every run's decisions are stored after the response; no answer or evidence is sent to the client before the test is submitted.
backend/services/book_ingestor.py: Extracts text from PDF and EPUB, chunks it by paragraph to about 600 words, and runs a claimed ingestion job from its cursor in bounded batches (five, then 16): embeds each batch with the local model, upserts it on (book_id, chunk_index), has the question generation agent fill the bank (and concepts) for the batch, marks the book ready once the first batch and its questions are stored, and saves the cursor; stores each chunk's reader blocks beside its unchanged content and the book's toc when it becomes ready (book_structure.build, once per job, never failing it); a failure is recorded on the job. Reads the file from Storage when resuming. Reads the file's own title and author (PDF info, EPUB OPF) and, once a job finishes, looks up the book's cover through covers.py unless it was looked up before; a failed lookup never fails the job. C17.6: stores chunks.block_paths beside the blocks and the book's own contents in books.toc; once done, hands the book and its bytes to region_job.after_ingest (C18.2b).
backend/services/retriever.py: Hybrid retrieval over one book's chunks: local-embedding vector search (match_chunks_local) and Postgres full-text search (search_chunks_text) merged with reciprocal rank fusion; get_similar_chunks keeps its signature.
backend/services/supabase_client.py: Creates the shared service-role Supabase client with its own HTTP/1.1 httpx pool (thread-safe; the default single HTTP/2 connection broke under threads, issue 29); fetch_all runs independent queries at once on worker threads; raises at import if the URL or key is missing.

backend/tests/test_ingest_embeddings.py: Pytest on the in-memory database: bounded batches from the cursor, every chunk stored once with a local embedding and the job done, the book ready only once the first batch and its questions are stored, ready even if those questions fail, a crash keeps the cursor and a resume from Storage finishes without duplicate chunks or questions, a batch stored but not recorded is safe to rerun, error before the first batch, an empty book, a failing question agent; the cover lookup after ingestion (typed title as fallback, metadata preferred, skipped once checked, never failing the job, not run when ingestion fails); reader blocks stored with every chunk and the toc with the book, an empty toc without chapters, no structure never failing the job, blocks for every chunk after a resume.
